problem_statement: The PM policy event API must behave safely when events are misused. Re-registering an event that is already registered must not create a duplicate entry in the event list; instead it must behave the same as updating the event's time (updating the single existing entry to the new time). Calling update() or unregister() on an event that is not currently registered must be a clean no-op that leaves the set of registered events unchanged. These behaviours must be observable through pm_policy_next_event_ticks(): after re-registering an event and later unregistering it, the next-event time must reflect only the remaining genuinely-registered events, with no stale duplicate lingering.
